title: aliciella subacaulis
intro: Aliciella subacaulis, commonly known as the pale gilia, is a flowering plant species found in the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Aliciella subacaulis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
